args.title: Parse quoted column names in statement headers
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Use splitFields on the header line instead of a naive .split(",") so that quoted column names in the header are correctly parsed and unquoted, preventing row shape mismatches on statements with quoted headers.
